text:
Mira: Kicking off a runbook thread for ap-southeast1 region bring-up — focus: GitOps/Helm apps, image registry replication for GPU images, artifact sync, and validation smoke tests. Need owners for helm + registry + CI mirroring. @Alex? @Dan? :wave:

Alex: I'll take Helm/ArgoCD. Plan: add a new Helm overlay in infra/gitops with GPU nodeSelector and tolerations. Example values I will include in the chart:
```
nodeSelector:
  accelerator: nvidia-t4
tolerations:
  - key: "nvidia.com/gpu"
    operator: "Exists"
resources:
  limits:
    nvidia.com/gpu: 1
```
I'll also add an ArgoCD Application manifest and a pre-sync hook to create the GPU node pool and patch daemonset for the device-plugin.

Dan: I'll own registry replication. For Artifact Registry/ECR we prefer a CI-driven mirror job rather than always-on cloud replication (gives better control over which models replicate). Example commands and notes:
```
# create repo (gcp example)
gcloud artifacts repositories create gpu-images --repository-format=docker --location=us-central1
# NOTE: some cloud-managed replication options are limited; we'll use a replicator job in CI (kaniko/registry-sync)
```
My plan: CI pushes to primary registry, then a kaniko-based mirror pushes to target region registries. I'll add Terraform for target repos and IAM.

Jen: CI pipeline updates — added a pipeline template in infra/pipelines for kaniko mirroring. Snippet:
```
- name: Kaniko mirror
  uses: some/kaniko-action
  with:
    destinations: |
      us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/org/gpu-images:${{ github.sha }}
      asia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/org/gpu-images:${{ github.sha }}
```
Also added an image GC TTL job to expire old tags (configurable by model).

Sam: Quick cost callout — cross-region replication adds egress + storage costs. Recommendation: replicate only heavy/latency-sensitive models, use lifecycle rules (30d default), and enable on-demand replication for experimental models. Watch for registry GET rates during rollout.

CI-Bot: CI-Bot: pipeline infra/pipelines/kaniko-mirror.yml queued for branch refs/heads/ap-southeast1-setup. Link: https://ci.example.com/123 :robot_face:

Mira: Validation checklist draft — can we confirm items?
1) ArgoCD Application sync is green
2) GPU node pool provisioned, labeled (accelerator=nvidia-t4) and device-plugin DaemonSet running
3) Sample job pulls mirrored image and runs nvidia-smi successfully
4) Network egress to model shard endpoints and DNS is working
5) Small throughput load test (10 qps) runs without OOMs or high tail latency
6) Cost estimate doc updated and shared.
@Alex @Dan please add missing items.

Alex: Add pre-sync smoke step in Helm: cordon non-GPU nodes -> create gpu-smoke Job -> wait for completion -> check logs. Example run command for validation after deploy:
```
kubectl run gpu-smoke --image=asia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/org/gpu-images/smoke:latest --restart=Never --limits='nvidia.com/gpu=1' -- nvidia-smi
kubectl logs job/gpu-smoke
```
Also setting `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` in values so mirrored registries are used.

Dan: Replicator config (to be checked into infra/replicator):
```
replicator:
  source: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/org/gpu-images
  targets:
    - asia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/org/gpu-images
    - australia-southeast1-docker.pkg.dev/org/gpu-images
  retention_days: 30
  concurrency: 3
  retry_policy: exponential
```
I'll open a PR with Terraform to create the target Artifact Registry repos and the IAM roles required for the replicator service account.

Mira: Handoff checklist for when PRs are merged:
- runbooks/regional-onboarding.md updated with ArgoCD app path and replication status
- smoke test logs attached and marked as PASS
- cost estimate (storage + egress) added to the PR description
- schedule 30m handoff with infra-oncall + devex to confirm monitoring (Grafana dashboards for node GPU metrics, registry replication metrics)
Once those are green, we'll flip canary. :white_check_mark:
